Seller is liable for storage fees if delivery is delayed beyond two weeks.

Purchaser cannot assign the contract without Seller's consent.
Backcharges for labor, materials, or repairs must be approved in writing.
Warranty covers one year from initial operation.
Excludes normal use-related defects and improper installation.
Seller has the option to repair or replace defective parts without charge.
Claims must be made in writing within 15 days of learning facts.
This proposal is the entire agreement, superseding previous communications.
Pumps must pass visual and mechanical inspections before shipment.
Contact sales at 314/843-4437 or sales.lewis@weirminerats.com for inquiries.
Lewis Quotation No. 16-298-FH for TES Drain Back Tank Pump
Total cost for start-up and commissioning: $3,048.89
Total cost for 2 years operation: $22,747.41
Pump type: VMS-2412-1/2 with material specification 132
Performance rating curves provided for the pump
Lewis Pumps bulletin for size type J=73.5"
Material specifications include studs, nuts, and bolts
Studs with hex nuts are used in various parts of the pump
Specifications cover different sections including motor coupling and bearing housing
Hydrostatic test prices per pump unit: Volute, Suction Head & Discharge Elbow ($275), Steam Jackets Not Applicable.
Freedom of rotation test included in the price for each assembled pump.
Minimum submergence test priced at $1,550 per pump unit, available as witnessed or non-witnessed.
Material certifications and liquid penetrant testing prices: Material Certificates ($450), LP/MP Tests ($1,050-$650-$1,100).
Special painting options include standard paint color ($550) and customer-specified paint ($1,250).
Positive material identification adds $1,500 per pump unit if required.
Sole plates add $3,305 per pump unit if required.
Seals for bearing housing include standard generic lip seals ($650) and special INPRO seals ($1,575).
Motor testing includes current and power input tests, routine NEMA MGI test, high potential test, vibration test, and resistance of windings test (not applicable if required).
